Smith Ramirez and Huerta Clinic

Dear Colleague,

I am writing to provide a comprehensive overview of the recent consultation I had with Michael Williams, who visited on November 4, 2024. The purpose of this consultation was to address his PTSD, among other chronic conditions.

First, let's discuss Michael's Anemia / blood disorders, specifically related to his venous thromboembolism (VTE) and factor V Leiden mutation. Michael's condition is currently controlled, and he is not on any medications to manage this particular Regular monitoring is advised to ensure continued stability.

Regarding his Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), which began May 2010, Michael reports that his condition is currently controlled. There are no medications being prescribed at this time, but ongoing therapy and support remain essential for his mental well-being.

Next, we reviewed Michael's Barrett's esophagus, which has other dysplasia. His condition remains controlled, and no specific medications are required for this diagnosis at the moment. Regular endoscopic surveillance is recommended to monitor for any changes.

Michael's Adrenal insufficiency / pituitary adenoma, specifically adrenal insufficiency, is well managed with hydrocortisone 5 mg daily. His current regimen effectively maintains his adrenal function, and there are no reported side effects from this medication. It is crucial to maintain his regular follow-up appointments to ensure continued control of this condition.

Lastly, we discussed Michael's status post inguinal hernia repair, which took place in October 2016. His recovery is progressing well, and he has no complications from the surgery. There are no medications required for this condition at this time.

During the visit, Michael's blood pressure was recorded at 108/72, and his weight was 241 pounds. His physical examination was otherwise unremarkable, with no acute distress noted. Michael also mentioned that he exercises regularly, running 3-4 times a week, which is beneficial for his overall health. Socially, Michael consumes alcohol approximately one drink per week.

In summary, Michael's multiple chronic conditions are well managed. His adherence to the recommended treatment plans and lifestyle modifications is commendable. I recommend continuing with the current management strategies and regular follow-up appointments to ensure sustained control of his conditions.

Thank you for referring Michael for this consultation. Please do not hesitate to contact me should you require any further information or have additional conc

regards,

Dr. Joanna Miller 
Family Medicine Specialist 
Smith Ramirez and Huerta Clinic
